accountId.description: The account these principal changes belong to.

oldState.description: The state this response starts from.

newState.description: The current state after all listed changes; pass to the next call.

hasMoreChanges.description: If true, additional changes exist beyond maxChanges. Call again with newState.

created.description: IDs of principals created since sinceState.

updated.description: IDs of principals whose properties changed since sinceState.

destroyed.description: IDs of principals destroyed since sinceState.
